requests.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production-oriented PRISON CAFETERIA game-scene concept for the mobile 2D puzzle/RTS-style escape game 《这次怎么逃》. The provided screenshot is the CURRENT GAME and exact camera/material/character-scale/HUD reference. Redesign ONLY the visible empty activity-hall environment into a believable prison cafeteria. This is one single landscape gameplay-screen concept, preferably1200×720 / 5:3 aspect. Keep full-screen world, do not create a promotional poster, cutaway dollhouse illustration, concept board, labels/arrows outside the screen or a device shell.

CRITICAL CAMERA: MATCH the screenshot's nearly top-down ORTHOGRAPHIC 2D game camera. Floor grid axes and walls are horizontal/vertical, table long edges perfectly horizontal. Furniture has only a modest thin front edge and short dark legs; low cutaway walls about18px thick, no tall walls occluding moving units. Characters are small upright 3/4 sprites about60–64 game-pixels high, not large illustrated people. NO diamond-isometric room, rotated floor axes, cinematic vanishing-point perspective or eye-level interior photograph. Match the screenshot's slightly pixel-textured HAND-PAINTED cartoon aesthetic; subdued sage gray-green worn stone tiles, warm ochre wooden tables/benches, pale cream stone wall tops, deep ink outlines and soft short contact shadows. Warm moderate daylight, clear details, not dramatic dark mood.

LAYOUT AT GAME SCALE: sparse functional room with clear mobile point-to-move floor space.
Upper side, mostly center and left of minimap: obvious CAFETERIA SERVING WINDOW. A long stainless/cream serving counter with little shallow trays holding rice/vegetables/soup, stacks of rectangular metal meal trays, a ladle and one warm soup pot. Behind it a LOW separating partition/open serving hatch into a modest visible kitchen with a stove, two pots, a sink and shelf. A small wall sign EXACT “取餐” or “食堂”. A subtle white-apron staff figure behind the partition may serve as visual context only, small same scale, no new playable role.
Left side: entry in a low wall connects to a simple short queue lane leading toward the serving counter, 1–2 understated rail sections/floor marks, NOT a maze of ropes. A broad parallel bypass corridor remains OPEN so queue never blocks all movement.
Center and lower-center: exactly FOUR long warm wooden dining tables, arranged TWO COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, with long benches on both sides. Same modest furniture scale as screenshot, about180–220 game-pixels long; sparse little meal trays/bowls on some tables, no ornate table settings. Keep generous clearance between rows and one broad continuous central aisle. Leave perimeter circulation as well. Benches and tables must not create tiny impassable gaps. Main passage widths at least80–100 game-pixels, wider near queue and turning points. Do not fill every gap with stools or decorations.
Right middle: distinct TRAY RETURN AREA, a small waist-height stainless rack with visibly stacked metal trays and two simple low bins for leftovers/utensils. Tiny real in-world label EXACT “餐盘回收”; no design callout box. It connects back to main aisle and avoids the bottom-right HUD.
Right side along the clear perimeter: ONE navy-uniform guard with cap, observing both serving line and dining aisle. No elevated watchtower. A very faint short warm forward-light wedge is okay, not a huge cone covering all tables.
All functional objects make the room unmistakably a prison dining hall, rather than four generic workshop benches.

CHARACTERS: the SAME THREE FRIENDLY INMATES from screenshot, all orange prison clothes, current small proportions. Inmate1 slim messy black hair, inmate2 round close-shaved/bald head, inmate3 square face brown swept SIDE-PART HAIR without hat. Distinguish with small1/2/3 badges. Show lunch at12:30: inmate1 near the serving counter carrying/receiving a visible meal tray; inmate2 seated naturally at a bench eating; inmate3 moving in the open central aisle holding a tray, with a clean teal selection ring at feet. No hand-holding chains, battle scene, large new crowds or special abilities. Keep selected inmate and meal targets clear from furniture/HUD.

HUD: keep only the current screenshot's restrained ivory paper HUD in its existing corner layout, NOT a redesign. Top-left compact clock EXACT “12:30” plus “吃饭休息”, a small “第1天 · 期限3天” line and its existing small日常表 button. Top-right compact “逃脱0/3”, coin0 and pause symbol. Small matching cafeteria minimap at upper-right, locate/collapse style minimal. Bottom-left three small numbered portrait cards, bottom-right currently selected backpack ONE EMPTY slot and stop icon. A very short unobtrusive lower-center reminder may read EXACT “午餐时间” but no tutorial paragraphs. The scene is dominant; HUD is a small style reference, text minimal. Do NOT introduce health bars, weapon buttons, joystick, stamina upgrades, restaurant-management revenue or shop menu.
Preserve enough corner margins for HUD, place critical kitchen/return/queue openings outside those overlays. Essential mood: modest ordered prison dining hall, simple food and worn furniture, warm comic game style. Beautiful yet feasible modular scene, not more realism than the reference.

Use case: precise-object-edit. This image is a finished top-down 2D prison CAFETERIA gameplay-scene CONCEPT. Make ONLY these three local corrections, preserve the exact overall camera, floor, all FOUR wooden dining tables/benches, serving window/food trays/kitchen, three inmates, right guard, return rack, material style, room proportions and HUD positions.
1. LEFT ENTRY: the narrow cream vertical low wall at screen-left currently closes the entrance. Remove one short wall section roughly between y310 and y470 (original1619×971 image coordinates), leaving a generous clear doorway/opening to the outside LEFT corridor. Matching continuous stone floor flows through it. Keep the wall above/below, no closed gate, no extra room or viewpoint. This doorway feeds the open queue/bypass area.
2. REMOVE the faint leftover Chinese label “活动大厅” under the upper-left日常表 button, replace that patch with matching empty stone floor. The existing 食堂 sign by the kitchen is sufficient; no additional giant label.
3. HUD selection must match the scene's selected inmate3 teal ring. Bottom-left card1 loses its teal selection border/check and becomes normal ivory like card2. Bottom-left card3 gets the teal outline and corner check (same existing style). Bottom-right title changes from “伙伴1 · 背包0/1” to EXACT “伙伴3 · 背包0/1”. Keep a single empty inventory slot and stop button. Do not change portraits, skills, stats, clock12:30, meal phase or any other text.
No redesign, no annotations, no external border, no new features. Keep whole landscape composition and same painterly rendering.

Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a prison CAFETERIA concept. The human player's direct feedback is: “The food looks far too good. This is a prison; food should not be this good.” Correct ONLY ALL visible FOOD and its service presentation to plain modest standardized prison rations; preserve camera, entire room layout, four tables/benches, opened left entrance, queue rail, kitchen partition, three inmates, guard, HUD and every label and character selection.

UNIFORM MEAL: a SMALL serving of off-white/coarse rice, a few dull gray-green boiled cabbage pieces OR 2–3 pale beige boiled potato chunks, and watery nearly clear soup. Very muted low-saturation, flat boiled texture. Restrained quantity, not overflowing. No meatballs, meat mountain, rainbow mixed vegetables, bright orange carrots, glossy sauces, abundant menu choices, garnish, gourmet plating or appetizing food-advert lighting. But NOT spoiled, rotten, dirty, bloody or gross—simply boring economical institutional food.

SERVING COUNTER: replace the current colorful vegetables and meatball-filled basins. Show only TWO open modest ration basins: one shallow rice/coarse grain container, one with plain gray-green boiled cabbage and a few pale potato pieces. Convert other colorful dish basins to closed dented brushed-aluminum lids/empty stacked trays, so it no longer feels like a varied buffet. The soup pot should contain pale watery soup with very few dull vegetable flecks, no rich golden stew. Match all rear kitchen pot contents; cover extra pots if needed. Replace colorful ingredient jars/food on the rear shelf with plain muted grain/storage tins, no colorful food display.
ALL PERSONAL MEALS: BOTH carried trays (inmates1 and3), the seated inmate2's tray, and every tray on all FOUR dining tables have the SAME humble small meal: small off-white rice mound, a few gray-green cabbage/pale potato pieces, a little watery broth. The compartments should mostly show worn dull gray ALUMINUM, not full colorful dishes. Add restrained dents/scratches to trays and simple plain metal cups/cutlery only, maintaining clean readable art.
TRAY RETURN: leftover bin nearly empty with a few dull cabbage/rice scraps, NOT a generous colorful meal. Keep stacked trays and utensils, the label remains exactly “餐盘回收” and bin labels unchanged.

Keep warm WOOD color and orange prison CLOTHING as they are; desaturate only FOOD/food presentation, not the whole game. Preserve gray-green floor, cream walls, dark ink cartoon rendering and small sprite scale. This change must be visible across counter, kitchen, carried plates, table plates and waste bin together. No new gameplay or extra objects beyond closing/reducing buffet basins. All other features remain fixed.
